production_route: Request start through client commit or rollback terminal in the existing hipfire-engine and hipfire-generate lifecycle owners
positive_probe: Request start, client commit, reset, abort, parser/tool/reasoning completion, chain/session, unload, and HTTP completion battery across current production routes
negative_or_fault_probes: Error, cancellation, or rollback emits exactly one terminal after synchronized rollback and leaves no cache/history/tool publication or stale request owner
Reset after success, abort, and failure leaves the model and session reusable; HTTP completion does not hang
sole_owner: hipfire-engine and hipfire-generate exclusively own request scheduling, parser, reset, cache, session, abort, terminal, and HTTP lifecycle.

revert_identity.scope: Revert the complete G4 request/session lifecycle transaction as one coherent unit; do not split scheduler, parser, reset, cache, session, terminal, or HTTP ownership.
